gaps.question: Does the world have a day and night cycle, and what does it change
answer: Forever: yes, a 24-hour cycle that follows a real clock; beta players put it on Pacific time. Blizzard developers discussed that clock for Oceanic players on the Oct 29 podcast and announced no change.
What it changes: the light and sky. Blizzard has published no day-only or night-only mechanic for Forever; Classic's only remnant of a more dangerous night was the worgen of Pyrewood Village.
Beta players found night very dark, with Tirisfal Glades the hardest zone to read after dark; Blizzard has not stated the launch clock.

gaps.question: Class trainers for a mixed-race party in Durotar
answer: Warcraft Tavern, Forever class trainer locations: Horde Druid trainers sit in Mulgore (Red Cloud Mesa to level 6, Bloodhoof Village, Camp Gev'rek), Thunder Bluff, Moonglade, Feralas, Dalaran and Zephras Isle; none in Durotar or Orgrimmar. The page flags its Dalaran druid trainer as "unclear if this is intentional".

Tauren overland route Mulgore to Durotar at level 1: no Forever source. A Warcraft Wiki travel guide gives Bloodhoof Village, Camp Taurajo, the Crossroads, Durotar and warns the Barrens is dangerous for low levels.
Unverified for Forever; settles at character creation Oct 27.

gaps.question: Horde warlock race ranking
answer: Orc, Troll, Undead for PvE damage, Undead for PvP. No Forever sim or guide ranking exists; the web search returned only WotLK and TBC race guides (Warcraft Tavern), which credit Orc's Command, a racial Forever's Create the Hero list does not give the Orc (two actives, two passives: Blood Fury, Shatter Curse, Savage, Hardiness).
Open: Berserking's cooldown, the Touch of the Grave drain amount (guides say about 5% of max health) and whether Blood Fury's spell power reaches a scaling pet. Settles with level 60 logs.

gaps.question: Which classes use guns
answer: Classic rule: Hunters (Dwarf and Tauren start with the skill; other hunter races train it), Warriors and Rogues (weapon master).
Forever: no deep dive changes weapon skills; unpublished. Engineering for non-engineers (Warcraft Tavern): SAF-T Dynamite / SAF-T Copper Bomb (new), bomb satchels, Reagent Bot, Repair Bot.

gaps.question: Tank counts per raid size
answer: Blizzard raid preview: Barrow Deeps 10 players / 8 bosses, Hyjal Summit 20 / 13, Onyxia's Lair 40 players; all "On December 9"; "all raids currently planned to reset each week"; Onyxia needs the Drakefire Amulet (faction attunement chain) and fire resistance.
Tank counts: no Forever source. Blizzard design line: tanks hold 3 to 5 targets (Kami Labs ep 2 recap).

gaps.question: Horde in Stormwind on a Normal realm
answer: Rule: guards attack enemy-faction players in range "regardless of whether PvP is enabled on the player or the type of realm". PvE-realm guards are stronger and respawn faster than PvP-realm guards; capital guards at or above max level; NPCs call 1 to 3 reinforcements.
gaps.status: No Forever rule yet; the old Classic rule is assumed

gaps.question: Character-name symbols
answer: Blizzard names article: no symbol rule; code of conduct applies, "repeated-character patterns may be restricted", filter evaluates both parts together.
Settles at character creation Oct 27 (pack buyers).

gaps.question: World bosses
answer: Forever: no world boss found in the library, Blizzard posts the library covers, or a web search.
Definition: a raid-level boss in the shared world rather than an instance, built for raid-sized groups of max-level characters.
Not Forever: the 21st Anniversary event bosses (Archavon, Doomwalker, Sha of Anger, a rotating Dragon of Nightmare) are a separate event.

gaps.question: Item durability
answer: Spirit Healer adds 25% on equipped and bag items. At 0%, items give no stats but can still be worn. Vendors that sell weapons or armor repair; Engineers can craft repair bots.
Version note: patch 12.0.7 removed combat-based durability loss. Not known whether Forever keeps combat loss.

Kami Labs (Uldaman page): "Classic let up to 10 players in, as a raid group; Forever caps entry at 5.".
Zockify: most dungeons up to 10, UBRS 10.
